scope: RP1 Cadence GEM attachment/platform candidate, with checked generic CGEM ownership cleanup. Native compilation and mocked register/clock/GPIO/DMA tests only.

references.role: BSD RP1 hardware clock quirk and MAC/clock cleanup review; not assumed merged or qualified.
Primary comparison of RP1 fixed125MHz TX, RGMII userIO and DT AXI pipeline semantics; no GPL code copied.
Primary register-field comparison for AXI read/write pipeline and userIO.

behavior.rp1_tx_input_at_10_100_1000: fixed; MAC divides internally, no pclk/tx_clk rate changes on link changes
behavior.phy_reset: MAC-node GPIO acquired with active-low respected; selected5ms assertion and default10ms post delay; failed assertions retain a deassertion owner.
behavior.dma: Existing CGEM64 rings and parent translated DMA tag retained; require64bit hardware capability for RP1; checked descriptor-load callback and non-contiguous priority nullqueue setup.
behavior.cleanup: Bounded TX halt/RX disable before DMA release; tracked callout/IRQ/ifnet/child/map/tag/GPIO/clock/resource owners; retry preserves each failed owner and softc.

validation.native_build_note: Original bsd.kmod.mk/if_cgem Makefile with build-only candidate header include root prepended; no install/load. Added missing gpio_if.h/clknode_if.h to source module Makefile.
validation.production_callbacks: Clang18/GCC ASan+UBSan pass using production attach, setup_descriptors, stop/reset, detach, PHY, clock, MDIO, AXI, MAC/FDT helper, media and DMA callback code. Faults across acquisitions, callback-only mapping errors, stuckTX timeout and every fallible release/retry; optionalRX-clock absence allowed.

limitations: No selected Pi5 kernel boot, physical PHY reset/MDIO/link/DHCP/packet traffic or full-RAM DMA acceptance yet.
Changed generic CGEM cleanup is locally/native-compile tested but not physically regressed on other SoCs.
RP1 clock provider can calculate lower divider rates, but the Ethernet MAC must keep its TX input125MHz at every link speed. Earlier proposed dynamic Ethernet TX-clock adjustment was incorrect.
BCM2712/Pi4/legacy SD operation and broader all-Pi hardware matrix remain separate open requirements.
